electrical_system_description.value: STIHL Virginia Beach industrial plant with multiple electrical sub-projects: (1) MS3 & MS4 switchboard replacement — two 4000A, 480Y/277V switchboards, each fed by a 2,500 kVA pad-mounted transformer (Dominion utility), 53,829A available fault current, short circuit/coordination study performed using SKM Power Tools; (2) Plant 5 / Warehouse 5 new 5000A, 480Y/277V switchboard (SWBD-W5), total demand 3,191.4 kVA / 3,835.8A; serving panels for EV charging, battery chargers, unit heaters, infrared heaters, and mechanical equipment; (3) Data center MCB 3&4 study; (4) IMM accessories power; (5) Guide Bar Plant emergency power (2022 and 2025 drawings); (6) Tap box/busway design.
